otherSession: Second session of the day: {{name}} stays logged separately, nothing is replaced.
howTo: Tap the tick when you finish a set: empty fields fill with last time's numbers and the timer starts with the planned rest (in a superset, after the second exercise). The timer keeps running if you switch screen or lock the phone.
sessionNotesPlaceholder: How it felt, machine settings, aches
firstTime: First time: pick a weight you can lift for the top of the range with the RIR shown.
noProgram: No training program loaded. Import your backup from Settings.
